title: Accounts and connection
acceptance: Through the real local v0.3 launchers, create the first owner, enroll existing accounts, invite a member and sign in with a username and password. Preserve private homes and preferences through upgrade and recovery. Restore authorized routes after refresh and browser reopen. Verify current-session and all-session sign-out with two independent sessions for one account and an unaffected second member. Demonstrate member reset, owner code and server-machine recovery, polished MUI forms and independent workspace regression QA against the PI plan. In Profile, rename to an available username, change password, edit an introduction and optional email, and add, replace or remove a picture. Demonstrate member self-deletion, last-owner protection, private Home isolation and restoration before the 30-day deadline, then permanent cleanup on a separate expired fixture.
